purposes: One neuron: a linear fit ŷ = wx + b trained by gradient descent on the squared error.
Dot product: a weighted sum s = ∑ wᵢxᵢ, one multiply per pair and one running sum.
Matrix multiply: every cell of C is a dot product, the row of A with the column of B, summed over k.
Softmax: turn a vector of scores into probabilities, each score exponentiated and divided by the sum of all of them.
